decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures the required reader button and secondary post-verification PDF link in the transactional email contents.
Changing the ebook reader to a login-gated preview with a secondary download link does not alter the About-page content requirement.
The reader-access decision does not require a change to the FAQ state; the separate FAQ clauses in the same message are already represented independently.
Login-gated ebook preview and post-verification PDF download do not change Transak payment, wallet provisioning, or mint-destination behavior.
The reader must be login-gated, but the source does not unambiguously establish that the reader uses the one-time-email-code authentication path rather than another verification mechanism.
The source requires a login-gated reader but does not clearly state that SIWE is an allowed or required authentication path for ebook access.
The reader-access change does not alter the NFT token serial, referral-code persistence, or referral-code display locations.
The ebook preview and download-access decision is independent of automatic prize transfer and claim-control behavior.
Requiring login before ebook preview does not change which NFT-associated rights or state follow the NFT after transfer.
The ebook reader navigation decision has no effect on the randomness provider, draw execution, or verification surface.
The reader-access modification does not change secondary-sale royalty amount, structure, or disclosure.
The ebook reader access model does not affect the deferred Discord launch condition.
